explication: MLX Swift LM is a Swift library for loading and running LLMs and vision-language models on MLX, with related embedding, reranking, fine-tuning, guided-generation, and Foundation Models integrations. The principal workflow configures a model, loads its weights and tokenizer into a container, then generates conversational responses. README capabilities inform branches whose implementation wiring was not sampled; those branches are shown at API level rather than with inferred internal call chains.
